title: Pure Fabled
summary: Pure Fabled discard-Synchro build led by the 2025 wave (The Fabled Behilmoth, Fabled Gammajin, Fabled Levilazebul, and Fabled Realm's Revival), paired with generic staples. Every Fabled monster triggers when discarded to the GY—Special Summoning itself, reviving a partner, or searching—to fuel draw-heavy Synchro climbs.

summary.title: Starters
points: The Fabled Behilmoth discards itself alongside 1 or more other Fabled monsters from the hand to Special Summon a Fabled Synchro Monster from the Extra Deck whose Level equals their combined original Levels (treated as a Synchro Summon).
Fabled Marcosia discards up to 2 monsters (including a Fabled) to Special Summon itself with 200 ATK per discard, and searches a Fabled Spell/Trap when discarded to the GY.

Fabled Grimro sends itself from the hand to the GY while you control a Fabled monster to search any Fabled monster (except Grimro), while Fabled Realm's Revival Sets a Fabled Spell/Trap directly from the Deck on activation.

summary.title: Opening: The Fabled Behilmoth + Fabled Marcosia (or Level 2 Fabled)
steps: Activate The Fabled Behilmoth (Level 2) in hand, discarding itself and a Level 2 Fabled (The Fabled Cerburrel or Fabled Krus) to Synchro Summon Level 4 Fabled Gammajin; the discarded Cerburrel or Krus also triggers in the GY to summon a monster.
Trigger Fabled Gammajin on Synchro Summon to Special Summon Fabled Marcosia or Fabled Kushano directly from the Deck.

Tune Gammajin (a Level 4 Synchro Tuner) with a Level 1 Fabled (Fabled Lurrie) into Level 5 Fabled Ragin to draw until you have 2 cards in hand, or with a Level 6 body into Level 10 Fabled Levilazebul.
Use Fabled Realm's Revival (searched by Marcosia) to Set Fabled Treason and draw 1 card or revive a Fabled monster by discarding.

summary.title: Discard Triggers & Hand-Size Manipulation
summary.text: Fabled monsters reward emptying and refilling your hand: Fabled Lurrie and The Fabled Cerburrel (Tuner) mandatory Special Summon themselves whenever discarded; Fabled Krus revives a Level 4 or lower Fabled when discarded; Fabled Kushano returns itself from the GY to the hand by discarding another Fabled; The Fabled Abanc revives itself by discarding a Fabled; and Fabled Raven discards any number of cards to increase its Level and ATK accordingly.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Fabled Levilazebul (Level 10 Synchro) Tributes any number of Fabled monsters on the opponent's Main Phase as a Quick Effect to permanently take control of that many face-up monsters the opponent controls (with their effects negated), and recycles a Fabled from the GY to Special Summon itself.
The Fabled Unicore (Level 4 Synchro) negates and destroys every Spell, Trap, and monster effect activated by the opponent while both players have the exact same number of cards in hand.

Fabled Ragin (Level 5), Fabled Andwraith (Level 6), and Fabled Valkyrus (Level 8) draw cards to keep the Synchro chain going, while Fabled Leviathan recovers up to 3 Fabled monsters when destroyed and The Fabled Kudabbi is indestructible with an empty hand.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Fabled Realm's Revival Sets Stairway to a Fabled Realm or Fabled Treason from the Deck, prevents the opponent from activating cards or effects when a Fabled Synchro Monster is Synchro Summoned, and discards a Fabled once per turn to draw 1 card or revive a Fabled.
Stairway to a Fabled Realm sends a Fabled from the Deck to the GY on activation (like Fabled Kushano or The Fabled Abanc) and discards 2 cards to add a Fabled from the GY to the hand.
Fabled Treason discards 1 card from your hand to Special Summon a Fabled from your GY and destroy 1 card on the field (triggering your discarded Fabled on the opponent's turn).
